title: 数据倾斜：key 分布不均导致各分区负载失衡
expected_output:
总记录 = 100, 不同 key = 5
各 Reducer 负载(记录数) = [5, 85, 5, 5]
最大分区负载 = 85, 最小 = 5, 倾斜比 ≈ 17 : 1
结论: 单个热 key 占据绝大多数记录, 造成数据倾斜(某 reducer 长尾)
code:
from collections import Counter
def dhash(s):
    h = 0
    for c in s:
        h = (h * 31 + ord(c)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    return h
data = ["hot"] * 80 + ["a"] * 5 + ["b"] * 5 + ["c"] * 5 + ["d"] * 5
cnt = Counter(data)
num_reduce = 4
load = [0] * num_reduce
for k, v in cnt.items():
    load[dhash(k) % num_reduce] += v
mx = max(load)
mn = min(load)
print(f"总记录 = {len(data)}, 不同 key = {len(cnt)}")
print(f"各 Reducer 负载(记录数) = {load}")
print(f"最大分区负载 = {mx}, 最小 = {mn}, 倾斜比 ≈ {mx // mn} : 1")
print("结论: 单个热 key 占据绝大多数记录, 造成数据倾斜(某 reducer 长尾)")
